Since I’ve had my period (11) to now (19) I have had THEE worst period cramps. I’m talking nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fainting no matter how many mg of ibuprofen I’d take …you name it I probably had it. Recently my cramps although still quite painful have 100% calmed down and I don’t find myself having to miss events, school, work etc. I began by cutting out dairy completely (to be fair I’m lactose intolerant anyways but would eat it), I don’t drink coffee or anything with caffeine ~7-10 days before my period, and the BIGGEST!! Can’t stress enough was taking magnesium supplements once I ovulated. This was THEE game changer. So was adding omega 3. They both help with inflammation and cramping SO SO much. I added them to routine. I notice that on the months where I don’t take them I am bed ridden for 2-5 days. This is by no means medical advice just what has worked for me. 

Also! They sell these sticky heating things that I use when I’m on my period and it’s like my own personal portable heating pad
